topic: AI Safety Is Mostly a Sex Cult
headline: AI Safety and the Cult Complex
caption: As a full stack engineer observing the rise of AI safety discussions, I see parallels with closed-group dynamics rather than transparent scientific debate. There's a lot of hype around existential risks that seem more like social gatekeeping than grounded research. It's easy to get caught up in the fear-mongering and forget the importance of open, collaborative safety development. Let's focus on practical solutions that involve diverse voices rather than echo chambers. Keep questioning the motivations behind the hype and stay grounded in real engineering. 🚀 #AISafety #TechEthics #OpenScience
